treaty_name: Agreement between the Republic of Estonia and the Republic of Poland for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and on capital (1994)
eif_quote: Estonia MoF table (No. | Jurisdiction | Initialled | Signed | Ratified | In force from | Effective from | MLI effective from): 48. | Poland | 01.07.1993 | 09.05.1994 | 23.11.1994 ( est ) Tax Treaty with Poland (English).pdf | 296.97 KB | pdf | 09.12.1994 | 01.01.1995 | 01.01.2022
source_title: EE-PL Agreement 1994, English text published by Estonian MoF (fin.ee 'Tax Treaty with Poland (English).pdf'); Estonian text RT akt 13107355; MLI synthesised text

rates.quote: a) 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which holds directly at least 25 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends;
b) 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.
if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the interest the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.
if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the royalties the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: Synthesised text (fin.ee): "The following paragraph 1 of Article 7 of the MLI applies and supersedes the provisions of this Agreement: ... a benefit under this Agreement shall not be granted ... if it is reasonable to conclude ... that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction ..." ; Estonia Art. 35(7)(b) notification lists "40 Poland 25.11.2021"; fin.ee: "the provisions of the MLI enter into effect to the 7 tax treaties listed in the notification from 1 January 2022."

notes: Interest exempt at source for Government (incl. subdivisions/local authorities), Central Bank, wholly-owned financial institutions and government-guaranteed loans (Art. 11(3)). WHT effective from 1 January 1995 (Art. 29(2)(a)). No MLI Art. 8 (Estonia did not opt in).
